title: English Language — Form 4
description: A fourth-year secondary English course preparing for the O Level cycle: error correction, sentence transformation, gerunds and infinitives, advanced comprehension, summary practice, word formation and proverbs, discursive essays, articles and letters to the editor, complaint letters, narrative writing and listening, with Cameroonian examples and original exercises.
